description: This file defines the class 'MockLegacySecurityDevice', a Java source file for a mock device representing a legacy security device within a Zigbee-based system. It includes device properties, capabilities, behaviors, and related nested classes/enums.

classes.name: MockLegacySecurityDevice
classes.description: A Java class representing a mock security device with capabilities such as battery monitoring and temperature measurement. It provides properties, constructors, and methods to manage device state, perform upgrades, and interact with its underlying security cluster.

classes.name: MockLegacySecurityDevice.EnablesBitmap
classes.description: Static inner class defining constants for enablement bitmap bits used to track enabled features on the device.

classes.name: MockLegacySecurityDevice.StatusBitmap
classes.description: Static inner class defining constants for status bits indicating various device states or alarms.

classes.name: MockLegacySecurityDevice.DeviceType
classes.description: Enumeration of device types (e.g., door/window, smoke sensor, keypad) with associated byte identifiers.

classes.name: MockLegacySecurityDevice.UCTemp
classes.description: Class representing temperature data with conversion to byte array format.

classes.name: MockLegacySecurityDevice.LegacyRegion
classes.description: Enumeration of regional codes (US, CH, JP, AU) with associated byte region codes.
